label: RSS feed
intent: The feed publishes. Light: the dot fires with a pop; the outer wave travels out and fades, the inner wave travels out to take its place, and a fresh inner wave is born at the dot and swells out to its spot, overshooting a touch and settling. Strong: the dot draws in and the waves pull back first, then a bigger pop sends the outer wave further and the fresh wave lands with two settling beats. The dot never leaves its spot.

arc-inner.r.//: travels out to the outer radius, hands over to arc-outer at the same frame, then a fresh wave grows out of the dot

arc-outer.r.//: the old wave leaves and fades, then waits unseen at rest for the hand-over
